collections.title: FreeDict community dictionaries
collections.short: Plain bilingual word lists built by volunteers.
collections.description: FreeDict is a long-running open project of human-edited bilingual dictionaries. In the ACoLi Dictionary Graph these appear as OntoLex RDF and TIAD translation tables. Best for teaching lookup, cognate browsing, and open redistribution (GPL).
contents: Many European and a few other language pairs
User-generated quality — useful, not gold-standard lexicography
collections.quality: Community-edited word lists; coverage uneven by pair
collections.citation: Chiarcos, Fäth, Ionov (LREC 2020): The ACoLi Dictionary Graph; FreeDict editions.
collections.reference: Cite FreeDict for the lexica and ACoLi Dictionary Graph (LREC 2020) for the Linked Data edition.

graph.note: Bipartite link graph over loaded rows

senses.note: Sense URIs present; full OntoLex glosses not in TIAD

reverse.note: Many pairs have a flipped sibling table

collections.title: MUSE bilingual embeddings dictionaries
collections.description: MUSE dictionaries come from Facebook’s multilingual embedding work: automatically aligned word pairs with strong precision. Excellent for experiments and seed lexicons; not freely redistributable for commercial use.
contents: Lemma-like surface forms aligned across languages
Typically English-centric and many European pairs
collections.source_project: MUSE / Facebook AI Research via ACoLi TIAD edition
collections.citation: Lample et al., MUSE; ACoLi Dictionary Graph TIAD edition (CC BY-NC 4.0).
collections.reference: Non-commercial use. Cite MUSE + ACoLi Dictionary Graph; keep NC constraint.

embeddings.note: Original MUSE vectors are outside this TIAD table

collections.title: Apertium machine-translation dictionaries
collections.short: Lexicons designed for rule-based machine translation.
collections.description: Apertium bilingual dictionaries are curated for MT systems. ACoLi republishes them as Linked Data with richer structure than plain word lists.
contents: Often include morphological / category hints in the RDF edition
collections.quality: Curated for MT; good structural quality
collections.reference: Cite Apertium and the ACoLi conversion when publishing.

lookup.note: TIAD bilingual tables indexed for search

senses.note: Sense-chain URIs in TIAD; richer structure in RDF

morphology.note: Category tags often encoded in entry URIs

reverse.note: Few flipped siblings in this slice

collections.title: DBnary (Wiktionary as Linked Data)
collections.description: DBnary extracts lexical data from Wiktionary editions. Huge coverage; quality follows Wiktionary’s community model.
collections.source_project: DBnary / Kaiko GETALP via ACoLi TIAD
collections.quality: User-generated at scale; noisy but broad
collections.citation: Sérasset, DBnary; ACoLi Dictionary Graph TIAD extracts.
collections.reference: Cite DBnary / Wiktionary lineage + CC BY-SA terms.

senses.note: Sense / translation URIs + lexinfo POS in TIAD

collections.title: Open Multilingual Wordnet
collections.description: OMW connects wordnets so senses can align across languages. ACoLi TIAD tables support concept-aware bilingual browsing (pair with CILI).
collections.quality: Sense-aware; smaller pair count than PanLex
collections.citation: Open Multilingual Wordnet; ACoLi Dictionary Graph.
collections.reference: Cite OMW / WordNet lineage for synset-based work.

senses.note: Princeton WN synset URIs in TIAD link column
